final_message: I parsed the log file by reading each entry line and matching the log entry pattern. I filtered entries with levels ERROR, SEVERE, or FATAL (case insensitive). For each such entry, I converted the timestamp to UTC in the required format, extracted the message after the last " | " separator, and summed the repeat counts from any following repeat lines. I accumulated the repeat counts by service. The output JSON file workspace/errors.json contains the list of error entries with the required fields and a counts_by_service summary. The output also follows the Acme log-triage conventions.
